_comment: KITTI -> COCO taxonomy mapping (default / strict). Follows the spirit of the official KITTI
protocol, where Van is 'don't care' for Car and Person_sitting is 'don't care' for Pedestrian.
Values: '<coco name>' = evaluated GT box of that COCO class;
'ignore:<coco name>' = crowd/ignore region for that class only (detections there are neither TP nor FP);
'ignore' = ignore region for every evaluated class.
COCO detections of classes not listed in evaluated_categories are dropped by COCOeval (not counted as FP).
